analytic_contract.injection_model: Adding x times the frozen robust sigma to scalar F_B increases contrast_z, b_minus_a_sigma and b_minus_c_sigma by exactly x because the frozen control distribution excludes the B neighborhood.
analytic_contract.verification: The analytic result must be consistent with recorded T3B +10sigma failure and +12sigma success for both targets.

success_semantics.PASS_RESIDUAL_SENSITIVITY_CHARACTERIZED: Both exact required injection SNR values are finite, consistent with the recorded injection bracket, and no T3B trial is reclassified.
success_semantics.BLOCKED_ANALYTIC_INCONSISTENCY: Any target has missing/nonfinite metrics or the analytic floor contradicts the frozen injection outcomes.

line_closure_rule: After successful T3C characterization, freeze the external ZTF+TESS replication line as no preregistered isolated-B replication detected, with explicit unresolved sensitivity/archive limitations; do not continue optimizing this motif without a new independent preregistration.
